text:
kevin: whos up for a hybrid retro vs modern LAN next Sat? thinking 6pm start, emulation corner + modern multiplayer. projector for classics, low-lag monitors for shooters. Prize: mystery steam bundle. :mystery_box:
zoe: love this. can bring CRT + Dreamcast for authenticity. also a PS4 with DBZ fighter if ppl are into couch brawls.
mike: i'll bring a PC for Rocket League and a Switch dock. also got an Elgato for capture if we need clips.
riley: can do snacks and a mini bracket for Smash (friendly rules). vegan chips ok? :chip:
nora: i can bring extra HDMI cables, surge protectors, and 4 folding chairs. projector only has one HDMI in - is there an HDMI switch?
kevin: i can bring a 3-in HDMI switch and some Cat6 runs. ops-bot: quick check 1 are we allowed to have a CRT on the mezz?
ops-bot: Facility note: CRTs are allowed but please bring a mat and check weight limits. No soldering or electrical mods on site.
zoe: good call. i'll bring a mat and a tiny smoke detector (jk).
mike: small poll - prefer teams or free-for-all for modern multiplayer? reply with :team: or :ffa: in the event.
riley: team for RL, ffa for Smash maybe?
ora: team. less chaos.
kevin: cool. i'll post a short form for signups and gear checklist. pls mark what youre bringing so we don't double up. see y'all saturday! :nerd_face:
